//: Rules for the new engineCollab nodes used by AJG Engine Part C (Collab Requests + live sessions) and Part D (multiplayer rooms in exported games). They must be MERGED into the existing ajg-games Realtime Database rules (which already cover games/library/whitelist) — do NOT replace the whole ruleset with this file. Publish in the Firebase Console, project ajg-games, as averygroshans. FIX 2026-11-10: the requests list and the multiplayer player list read at the PARENT path (requests / rooms/<code>/players), so those parents need their own .read — a .read only on $id does NOT let a query or child_added listener see anything, which is why sent requests showed 'No requests yet.' requests also needs .indexOn toAddress for the orderByChild query.
//note: Follows the same public-read + shape-checked-write pattern as the existing ajg-games rules.json. Auth is NOT enforced here because the engine signs in to the ajg-mail project, not the ajg-games project, so the games database cannot verify who is writing (same honest limit as the existing games/library/whitelist rules).

$id..write: newData.exists() && newData.child('fromUid').isString() && newData.child('fromUid').val().length > 0 && newData.child('fromAddress').isString() && newData.child('fromAddress').val().length > 0 && newData.child('toAddress').isString() && newData.child('toAddress').val().length > 0 && newData.child('projectId').isString() && newData.child('projectId').val().length > 0 && newData.child('projectName').isString() && (newData.child('status').val() === 'pending' || newData.child('status').val() === 'accepted' || newData.child('status').val() === 'declined') && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber()

scene..write: newData.exists() && newData.child('objects').exists() && newData.child('code').isString() && newData.child('byUid').isString() && newData.child('byUid').val().length > 0 && newData.child('byAddress').isString() && newData.child('updatedAt').isNumber()

$id..write: newData.exists() && newData.child("name").isString() && newData.child("name").val().length > 0 && newData.child("x").isNumber() && newData.child("y").isNumber() && newData.child("z").isNumber() && newData.child("yaw").isNumber() && newData.child("updatedAt").isNumber()
